heading: Where they went
intro: Two main waves of emigration, drawn as a simple route map. It shows destinations, not exact journeys, and it is not to scale.

waves.note: Almost a sixth of Greece's population emigrated, mostly to the United States and Egypt.
More than one million Greeks emigrated, mainly to Western Europe, the United States, Canada and Australia.

source.text: Migration Policy Institute, Greece: A History of Migration (Kasimis and Kassimi, 2004)
